BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to military monuments; adding a new section tochapter 38.40 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the military andits personnel play a vital role in defending the lives and freedom ofall Americans. The legislature intends to honor the contribution ofthe military by the establishment of appropriate monuments located onstate property near each military base in the state.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 38.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The military department, in consultation with the department oftransportation, shall erect and maintain a monument to be constructedfrom permanent materials, such as masonry, stone, or concrete, at anappropriate location on state property near each military base in thestate. The purpose of the monument is to alert persons as to thepresence and location of the military base. The monument, at aminimum, shall identify the military base's name, branch of service,and appropriate military insignia. To the extent possible, and in p. 1 SB 5214conformance with applicable traffic safety standards as determined bythe department of transportation, these monuments shall be uniform insize and design throughout the state.
